name: Layershift Enscale
line: Deploy managed applications and databases on a container PaaS.

free.text: 14 days: public IP off by default, no Elastic VPS; paid upgrade needs deposit

cells.type: Certified stacks managed; custom Docker/VPS self-managed
cells.regions: UK, US and Singapore; Manchester default

work.math: An example of 2 cloudlets reserved for 730 hours = 1,460 cloudlet hours. Rates for builds, disk, traffic, public IP and HTTPS certificates are not published.
1 GiB needs 8 cloudlets, which is 5,840 cloudlet hours. The vCPU entitlement is not verified. Rates and the smallest qualifying plan are not published.
The app and the database each need 8 cloudlets for 1 GiB, which is 11,680 hours combined. Disk, traffic and seven daily dumps of unknown size are not priced.
